articles.summary: Matt Windisch is President of Kennedy Wilson. Matt oversees many of the company's key business units while also spearheading corporate acquisitions and providing oversight of public and private capital market activities.
articles.title: Matt Windisch

articles.summary: In Ku Lee is Executive Vice President and General Counsel of Kennedy Wilson. He is in charge of all of Kennedy Wilson’s public company regulatory and corporate governance matters and serves as the Chief Compliance Officer of KW Investment Adviser. Mr. Lee is also responsible for all legal aspects of Kennedy Wilson’s corporate and transaction capital raising, including public and private offerings of equity and debt.
articles.title: In Ku Lee
